textSegments: Complies with ATX12 v3.1 & EPS12 v2.92
The Future is Now：ATX 3.1 & PCIe Gen 5.1 Ready

Following the latest ATX 3.1 & PCIe Gen 5.1 regulation, support up to 200% power excursion and with the new interface of PCIe 12V-2x6 connector to ensure peak performance with future hardware upgrades.
*700W models are available with PCIe Gen 5.1 connector
Reliable Circuit Design for Steady Power
The +5V & 3.3V DC to DC circuit design enhances efficiency and stabilizes output voltage for consistent system performance.
230V EU Standard certification for lower power loss, less heat, and quieter operation.
Engineered for power-hungry VGA cards, this design delivers robust power to handle even the most demanding overloading conditions, ensuring peak performance in every gaming session.
A minimum power factor of 0.9 guarantees both system stability and efficiency.
Built with optimized thermal solution and an advanced 120mm HYB fan for cooler components and quieter operation.
With a hold-up time of over 12ms at 100% load, HYPER 80+ ensures uninterrupted performance during voltage dips.
Thermal Resilience: Power You Can Depend On

The HYPER 80+ power supply is engineered for reliable power delivery, even in temperatures up to 40°C. Count on stable performance for your everyday computing, ensuring system longevity without heat concerns.
*Performance data based on testing conducted at 25°C ambient temperature.
Engineered for reliability, HYPER 80+ features OVP, OCP, OPP, and SCP safeguards. From voltage spikes to short circuits, ensuring stable performance and maximum safety for your critical systems.
